answer: Sybil tax: forging an identity must burn real money, so bulk forgery fails. To join, an agent pays a sunk entry tax of 50 POA and locks a ferrous deposit of 200 POA for 20 epochs, receiving one non-transferable opal badge. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns 50,000 POA and locks 200,000 POA for nothing, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays 250 POA once and recovers it from real work, so honesty stays cheap and forgery stays ruinous.
